title: Prohibition in New Orleans versus Chicago
summary: Prohibition did not matter in New Orleans, but in Chicago it pushed trumpets out and clarinets forward.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
